pages.title: Barbee Fashion Influencer
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Build an event-ready wardrobe in Barbee Fashion Influencer. Choose clothing and accessories for photoshoots, special appearances, and everyday looks. Combine the available fashion pieces into outfits that fit each setting before completing Barbee's styling session.

pages.title: Color Ring Sorting Match
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Rearrange colored hoops in Color Ring Sorting Match. Drag rings between the available stacks, planning how matching colors can be brought together. Create useful combinations to clear the board while preserving enough room to move the remaining rings into place.

pages.title: Office Pyramid Solitaire
pages.creator: Sanoma
pages.description: Remove a card pyramid in Office Pyramid Solitaire. Pair uncovered cards whose values add to thirteen, or remove a king by itself. Matching suits doubles the points, and the harder setting also requires clearing the draw deck before the deal is complete.

pages.title: Battle Zone 2D
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Scavenge for equipment and outlast enemies in Battle Zone 2D. Explore the top-down battlefield for weapons, ammunition, and gear, then use cover during the fights. Aim with the cursor and switch weapons as the remaining opponents compete to be the final survivor.

pages.title: Ants Party
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Send a colony to dismantle giant snacks in Ants Party. Workers leave the anthill, bite pieces from food such as apples or cakes, and carry the portions home. Finish hauling away the entire treat to clear the level and face another food-collecting task.

pages.title: Legend of Fireball
pages.creator: TapNation
pages.description: Destroy objects with repeated fireball strikes in Legend of Fireball. Click to attack targets and earn currency, then buy upgrades that improve the character's destructive power. Unlock different fireballs and costumes while taking on timed challenges to clear more targets.

pages.title: Make Two
pages.creator: Orenji Spark
pages.description: Serve food in matching pairs in Make Two. Drag two identical dishes to the customer requesting them before the countdown expires. Fulfilled orders award coins that unlock more customers, while each level asks you to keep the pair-matching service moving quickly.

pages.title: Stickman Rescue Draw 2 Save
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Sketch protection around a vulnerable character in Stickman Rescue Draw 2 Save. Draw a shield, bridge, or supporting structure to handle hazards such as falling rocks, arrows, and pits. Plan how the line will interact with the danger before completing the rescue.

pages.title: Delta Force Airborne
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Coordinate shooting battles with a team in Delta Force Airborne. Use different character classes and map positions to confront opponents, aiming and firing while moving through the battlefield. Switch weapons when the encounter requires another approach and work with teammates toward the match objective.

pages.title: Greek Tower Stacker
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Construct an ancient-style high-rise in Greek Tower Stacker. Place successive floors of columns and arches on top of one another to increase the structure's height. Keep building the layered tower and pursue a taller result with the next stacking attempt.

pages.title: Help The Duck
pages.creator: Tiny Castle Studio
pages.description: Guide a duckling into its bath in Help The Duck Helping Little Duck. Direct water into the scene to push the duck toward the tub, choosing where the flow should act. Work out a route that brings the little bird down into the water.

pages.title: Super Pop Blast
pages.creator: JMJ Interactive
pages.description: Clear block arrangements with a limited supply of balls in Super Pop Blast. Hold and drag to aim, then release a shot toward the targets. Plan useful rebounds and build scoring combos while trying to earn three stars for the completed level.

pages.title: Mahjong Tour
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Travel through themed tile boards in Mahjong Tour. Select matching pairs to remove them and clear the whole layout before moving on. Buy power-ups when the remaining tiles make progress difficult, using them to help finish the current arrangement.

pages.title: Mojo Match 3D
pages.creator: Essence Games
pages.description: Search a scattered collection of objects in Mojo Match 3D. Select groups of at least three identical items to remove them permanently from the field. Each cleared set changes which pieces remain to inspect as you work toward completing the puzzle.

pages.title: Go To Zero
pages.creator: GMG
pages.description: Combine values and arithmetic symbols in Go To Zero. Work out which operations reduce the numbers to zero, removing elements as the puzzle develops. Clear everything from the screen to finish the stage and continue to a more demanding numerical arrangement.

pages.title: SPRUNKI 3D Escape
pages.creator: NISHAD_Games
pages.description: Search a three-dimensional setting for toys in SPRUNKI 3D Escape. Move through the rooms, use the flashlight, and collect the objects needed to finish the stage. Watch the countdown and the dangers that trigger jump scares while continuing toward the escape objective.

pages.title: Dream Restaurant 3D
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Build a growing burger business in Dream Restaurant 3D. Move through the restaurant to prepare food, carry stacks of burgers, and serve customers at their tables. Collect payments, hire waiters, and unlock more areas as the restaurant earns enough for expansion.

pages.title: Vampiric Roulette Romance
pages.creator: CGSpot
pages.description: Prepare four potential dates for an eclipse party in Vampiric Roulette Romance. Choose gothic clothing and makeup for the characters, then help the Vampire Prince through the game's roulette-style date reveal. Finish the looks before discovering which guest is selected.

pages.title: Color Cocktail
pages.creator: NovaSky
pages.description: Make drinks through fruit merges in Color Cocktail. Aim balls into a container and combine identical ones to form larger fruit pieces. Each merge contributes toward filling a customer's glass, building points while the next guests wait for their orders.

pages.title: Phone Case DIY Run
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Collect and decorate covers during a moving course in Phone Case DIY Run. Guide the line of cases through color painting, picture application, and pendant choices. Bring more finished cases to the end to increase the payment for the completed run.

pages.title: Solitaire Daily
pages.creator: Denda Games
pages.description: Clear a fresh card layout in Solitaire Daily. Rearrange tableau cards in alternating colors and build the ace foundations upward toward kings. Draw another card from the stock when needed and keep opening routes that allow more of the deal to reach the foundations.

pages.title: Pet Salon
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description: Look after visiting animals in Pet Salon. Bathe the pets and help them through the care activities available at the salon, including a visit to the doctor. Select the needed items to complete each animal's treatment before moving on to another pet.

pages.title: Animegao Kigurumi DIY
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Create a masked costume character in Animegao Kigurumi DIY. Design the face mask first, then choose makeup, an outfit, and accessories that suit the finished character. Complete the combination and save the result as a PNG image if you want a copy of the design.

pages.title: Goods Sort Master
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Sort merchandise inside three-dimensional cabinets in Goods Sort Master. Drag matching snacks, drinks, and fruit together on the shelves to form triples. Clear useful combinations within the available time and unlock more products as you work through the supermarket arrangements.

pages.title: Super Megabot Adventure
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Take a transforming robot into side-scrolling fights in Super Megabot Adventure. Change weapons, learn skills, and buy additional equipment while completing mission stages at different difficulties. After working through those assignments, try survival mode against continuing enemy encounters.

pages.title: Candy Mahjong Tiles
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Remove sweet-themed tile pairs in Candy Mahjong Tiles. Choose identical pieces that are open on the left or right, clearing them to expose more of the board. Match every tile to complete the stage and proceed to another arrangement.

pages.title: Mike And Mia 1st Day At School
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Help two children prepare for school in Mike And Mia 1st Day At School. Clean their room, put together a snack box, and choose clothing for the day. Finish the preparations before joining the school activities waiting for Mike and Mia.

pages.title: Snowball Rush 3D
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Grow a rolling mound of snow in Snowball Rush 3D. Slide to control its path and work toward bringing a larger snowball to the end of the level. Collect bonus crystals to unlock different appearances for the snowball in later runs.

pages.title: Gothic New Era
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Prepare a student for a new academy in Gothic New Era. Begin with facial care and gothic makeup, then choose a hairstyle and dark clothing. Combine dresses or school-uniform pieces with matching details to complete the heroine's look before her trip.

pages.title: Gem Stacker
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Turn raw stones into jewelry during a run in Gem Stacker. Guide the gem line through breaking, cutting, polishing, and upgrade stations, then sell the finished pieces to customers. Avoid obstacles so more gems survive the course and contribute to the earnings.

pages.title: Noob vs Pro vs Hacker vs God 1
pages.creator: Noob vs Pro team
pages.description: Recover stolen diamond apples in Noob vs Pro vs Hacker vs God 1. Follow the characters through zombie fights, vehicle sections, and boss encounters on the pursuit of Hacker. Choose the single-player story or a shared two-player contest for a different way to play.

pages.title: Find Out The Criminal
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Investigate a case in Find Out The Criminal. Search scenes for hidden clues, examine the evidence, and connect the discoveries to identify the person responsible. Work through the detective puzzles by checking what each new finding reveals about the crime.

pages.title: Charge Everything
pages.creator: Gamealliz
pages.description: Connect electrical devices to usable outlets in Charge Everything. Route plugs for phones, tablets, players, and cars around the obstacles in each arrangement. Work through wall barriers and use mechanisms such as windmills when the level requires a different path to power.

pages.title: Real Extreme Car Driving Drift
pages.creator: Best Free Games
pages.description: Drive and slide a vehicle in Real Extreme Car Driving Drift. Use the movement keys to control the car and press F for a burst of nitro. Manage acceleration and steering as you work through the driving simulation's routes and drifting sections.

pages.title: Paint The Fence
pages.creator: Flash From The Past
pages.description: Cover unusual surfaces in Paint The Fence. Move the brush with the mouse and hold to apply paint, switching colors with the number keys. Complete the painting task while working around obstacles, earning stickers and other bonuses as you progress.

pages.title: Gun Fest
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Expand an armed formation in Gun Fest. Guide the weapons through numbered walls, using blue gates to add guns and avoiding red ones that remove them. Orange gates produce changing values, so choose a route that leaves enough firepower to stop robbers and their getaway van.

pages.title: Dangerous Adventure
pages.creator: Flash From The Past
pages.description: Lead five adventurers through dungeon battles in Dangerous Adventure. Match gems to trigger attacks, defeat monsters, and open chests for gold. Spend the earnings at the tavern on hero improvements and equipment before entering another of the sixteen caves.

pages.title: Ball Merge 2048
pages.creator: TrendyGames
pages.description: Grow a numbered runner in Ball Merge 2048. Begin with a two-ball and collect matching values to double its number along the road. Steer around bridges and spikes while building toward 2048 through the progressively more difficult stages.

pages.title: Make All Happy
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Change the moods of a puzzle board in Make All Happy. Tapping a block toggles its state and those of its horizontal and vertical neighbors. Plan a sequence of taps that leaves every block happy without undoing the parts already arranged correctly.

pages.title: Fruit Mahjong
pages.creator: PotatoJam
pages.description: Connect matching produce tiles in Fruit Mahjong. Find two identical pictures linked by a clear path of no more than three straight segments, then remove the pair. Clear every tile from the board to complete the current connect-two puzzle.

pages.title: Chess Mania
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Solve tactical chess positions in Chess Mania. Use standard chess moves to checkmate the opposing king and advance through a tower of four hundred challenges. Complete achievements along the way to unlock more flags as the positions become harder to finish.

pages.title: Hidden Lands
pages.creator: Avix Games
pages.description: Compare floating landscapes in Hidden Lands. Find differences and concealed details that reveal the history of lost civilizations. Zoom in, drag the camera, and inspect each view carefully to locate the changes needed to complete the visual puzzle.

pages.title: Racecar Steeplechase Master
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Race past destructive barriers in Racecar Steeplechase Master. Guide the car through the course and reach the finish ahead of the competition. A collision with an obstacle ruins the vehicle, so find a clear route rather than driving straight into the next hazard.

pages.title: Extreme Bike Driving 3D
pages.creator: Driving games
pages.description: Explore city streets and off-road routes in Extreme Bike Driving 3D. Collect scattered money to unlock faster motorcycles, then use steering, braking, and nitro to handle the terrain. Change the camera or reset the bike when another view or position is needed.

pages.title: Flying Police Car Simulator
pages.creator: Driving games
pages.description: Switch between driving and flying in Flying Police Car Simulator. Explore city streets, rise between skyscrapers, and travel to an airport beyond the road network. Steer carefully around tall buildings, since a collision costs speed and sends the car back toward the ground.

pages.title: Golf Bounce
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Launch a penguin with a golf club in Golf Bounce. Send it across the jungle and use bounces to extend the distance traveled. Gather coins to buy improvements that support longer flights as you work toward reaching the far end of the course.

pages.title: Little girls kitchen Time
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Join two young princesses for a baking session in Little girls kitchen Time. Help make chocolate cookies by working through the kitchen's preparation steps. After the treats are finished, choose outfits to complete the characters' day of cooking and dressing up.

pages.title: Witch Crossword
pages.creator: Latimed
pages.description: Solve clue-based word puzzles in Witch Crossword. Choose a word to work on and click letters to form the answer, using the clues across different subject areas. Ask for a hint when the current question blocks further progress through the crossword.

pages.title: Adventure Escape
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Keep a space traveler aloft in Adventure Escape. Click or touch the screen to fly higher, adjusting the character's height as the ship's passages approach. Stay clear of the doors and avoid dropping down while continuing the attempt to leave the vessel.

pages.title: Racing 3D Extreme Car Race
pages.creator: hitNrun games
pages.description: Compete across different driving formats in Racing 3D Extreme Car Race. Choose endless driving, challenge stages, or multiplayer races and take the car onto the road. Unlock more vehicles and change camera views as you work through the available courses and opponents.

pages.title: Mahjong Firefly
pages.creator: TapLabGames
pages.description: Remove matching tiles from illuminated boards in Mahjong Firefly. Find accessible identical pieces and clear pairs to open further parts of the arrangement. Special tiles add effects that can help with later matches as you work through the sequence of levels.

pages.title: Mermaid Ruined Wedding
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Repair a celebration after a shark attack in Mermaid Ruined Wedding. Restore the ballroom and fix the damaged cake before choosing the mermaid bride's clothing. Complete the preparations so the princess and her prince can continue their underwater wedding.

pages.title: Us Army Missile Attack Army Truck Driving Games
pages.creator: ideagames
pages.description: Drive a missile-launching vehicle into combat in Us Army Missile Attack Army Truck Driving Games. Move the truck into position, aim its launcher, and fire at enemy targets. Complete the military transport and attack tasks while responding to the opposing force.

pages.title: Prison Escape Plan
pages.creator: Hitgames.org
pages.description: Plan a breakout for three inmates in Prison Escape Plan. Choose routes that guide the prisoners away from police and detection systems, checking the dangers around each path. Work through more than fifty escape layouts without letting the group get caught.

pages.title: Reversi
pages.creator: RedFoc
pages.description: Compete for a majority of discs in Reversi. Place a piece to enclose opposing discs between your own, flipping the captured line to your color. Play a friend or the computer on the eight-by-eight board and finish with more pieces than the other side.

pages.title: Angry Tiger Coloring
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Paint striped feline pictures in Angry Tiger Coloring. Choose one of eight drawings and use the twenty-three-color palette to fill its details. Build the color combination you want for the tiger, then save the completed picture at the end of the session.

pages.title: PonGoal Challenge
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Return the ball against a computer opponent in PonGoal Challenge. Adjust the court, ball appearance, opponent difficulty, and round duration before starting. Ball speed and rotation settings provide further ways to change the behavior of the ping-pong-style match.

pages.title: Cute Tiki Match 3
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Make rows of matching figures in Cute Tiki Match 3. Arrange three or more blocks of the same color together to remove them and score points. Keep creating combinations while watching the left-hand gauge, since letting it empty ends the attempt.

pages.title: Work Trucks Memory
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Reveal vehicle pairs in Work Trucks Memory. Flip cards to locate identical trucks and remove each matched pair before time expires. Successful matches add more time, rewarding remembered positions and giving you longer to clear the remaining cards.

pages.title: Christmas Connect Deluxe
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Clear festive tile boards in Christmas Connect Deluxe. Select identical pictures joined by a route of at most three straight segments to remove them. Finish each of the twenty-four layouts within its time limit, with quicker completions earning an extra bonus.

pages.title: Swing Rider
pages.creator: GameBiz
pages.description: Swing through an urban route in Swing Rider. Tap and hold to keep a character moving through the air, timing each swing as the city scrolls past. Continue with the available riders and work toward covering more of the route in each attempt.

pages.title: Neon Splash
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Reveal hidden designs with glowing liquid in Neon Splash. Swipe left or right to rotate the object and guide the fluid across its dark surface. Uncover the neon picture to finish the stage, then continue through the collection of more than a hundred and fifty levels.

pages.title: Magic World
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Clear a field of colored bubbles in Magic World. Aim and fire toward matching pieces to remove groups from the arrangement. Check the available angles before each shot so the next ball reaches a useful cluster instead of adding another obstacle.

pages.title: Brazilian Monster Truck Racing Game For Kids
pages.creator: hitNrun games
pages.description: Take a large vehicle onto desert tracks in Brazilian Monster Truck Racing Game For Kids. Select a monster truck and choose a level before beginning the off-road drive. Control the vehicle through the route's uneven sections and work through further racing challenges.

pages.title: Stylish Stack Jump Tap Jumping Game
pages.creator: Shiny Dust Studios
pages.description: Climb an expanding tower in Stylish Stack Jump Tap Jumping Game. Tap or press Space to jump onto an approaching block, timing the landing to reach the next level of the stack. A missed platform ends the climb, so keep judging each new block's arrival.

pages.title: Tattoo Salon Art Design
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Create body-art designs in Tattoo Salon Art Design. Use the mouse to work through the tattooing activity, turning the selected artwork into a completed decoration. Build the appearance of each design as you take the role of the salon's tattoo artist.

pages.title: King Way
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Carry a floating monarch around obstacles in King Way. Use a propeller to move the balloon supporting the king, guiding him toward every cheese in the stage. Collect the scattered pieces across twenty-eight levels while keeping the balloon clear of danger.

pages.title: Scary Granny: Basement Escape
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Find the doors out of a hostile basement in Scary Granny: Basement Escape. Explore with the movement keys and interact with objects while staying ahead of Granny. Run or jump when needed to continue searching for the exits without being caught.

pages.title: My Princess Room Decoration
pages.creator: Girls Games
pages.description: Furnish a royal bedroom in My Princess Room Decoration. Choose furniture, colors, and decorative details to build a new room for the princess. Compare the available combinations and arrange the interior into a finished design suited to her palace home.

pages.title: Save The Whale
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Keep a whale away from hunters in Save The Whale. Dodge harpoons, bullets, and bombs, following the yellow arrow toward sharks that provide power. Use the green arrow to locate a shield and keep swimming through the threats surrounding the whale.

pages.title: Monster Truck Hidden Keys
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Locate concealed objects in Monster Truck Hidden Keys. Find ten keys in each of six truck pictures before the time limit expires. Repeated incorrect clicks remove an additional five seconds, so examine the image carefully before choosing another hiding place.

pages.title: Classic Chicken Shooting
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Complete hunting targets in Classic Chicken Shooting. Aim at the chickens and shoot enough of them to meet the level's required total. Clear the current assignment to move on and face another group of birds to hit.

pages.title: Motocross Puzzle Challenge
pages.creator: yaine
pages.description: Put together off-road motorcycle scenes in Motocross Puzzle Challenge. Select a difficulty and connect the scattered image pieces to restore the picture. There is no countdown, so inspect the bike and background details at your own pace while completing the jigsaw.

pages.title: Cute Animals Coloring Book
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Paint a collection of animal illustrations in Cute Animals Coloring Book. Choose shades and apply them to the drawings, experimenting with different combinations for the animals and their details. Complete the picture in your preferred style and capture the result when finished.

pages.title: EG Penguin Puzzles
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Help a baby bird return to the water in EG Penguin Puzzles. Remove the right supporting blocks so the penguin slides down into its family's home. Think through the order of removals to avoid dropping the bird onto land instead.

pages.title: Pick Me Up
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Work as a ride-share driver in Pick Me Up. Hold to accelerate and release to brake, collecting passengers and taking them to their destinations. Avoid collisions, earn fares, and unlock additional cars while exploring locations marked by different monuments.

pages.title: EG Flying Truck
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Fight above the skyline in EG Flying Truck. Pilot an anti-gravity vehicle through aerial encounters with other flying trucks, shooting threats as the route continues. Keep the truck moving through the rooftop battles to travel farther and improve the distance score.

pages.title: The Rings
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Arrange colored hoops into matching lines in The Rings. Place rings on the board so a straight row of one color can be cleared. Keep space available for the next pieces, since the game ends when no further ring can fit.

pages.title: Bounce Ball
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Arrange a path of rebounds in Bounce Ball. Tap blocks to rotate them, setting their angles before touching the ball to start its movement. Direct the ball toward the goal and collect stars by planning how it will bounce through the layout.

pages.title: Rock Paper Scissors
pages.creator: Gemini Games
pages.description: Judge the outcome of hand-game rounds in Rock Paper Scissors. Inspect both players' choices and declare the winner or select a draw before time expires. An incorrect judgment or late response costs one of the five available lives.

pages.title: Endless Golf
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Work through a continuing series of holes in Endless Golf. Aim the ball toward the cup and judge the course before taking another stroke. Complete the current layout to move on, adapting the shot to the next hole's position and shape.

pages.title: Shape 3D
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Switch lanes through geometric obstacles in Shape 3D. Use the left and right controls to find a safe route and gather tokens along the way. Choose between two modes, keep the run going, and build a higher score before an obstacle ends the attempt.

pages.title: Avoid The Tow Truck
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Stay ahead of a pursuing vehicle in Avoid The Tow Truck. Click or tap to change the direction of movement, keeping the car away from the truck trying to catch it. Continue adjusting the route to extend the chase without being intercepted.

pages.title: Drift Car Driving
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Explore a stunt-driving area in Drift Car Driving. Take a sports car through the available locations and practice controlling its direction through turns. Roam the routes at your chosen pace as you investigate the driving setting.

pages.title: Animals Blast
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Set off a chain reaction in Animals Blast. Burst creatures so their effects reach other animals and continue the sequence. Plan the first detonation to remove every animal in the layout, clearing the stage and opening another arrangement to solve.

pages.title: Viking Puzzle
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Clear a path back to the ships in Viking Puzzle. Combine colored bricks to remove the barriers blocking the Vikings, working around the extra blocks their strikes produce. Finish the matching task before the approaching arc of electricity catches the stranded group.

pages.title: Arkadium's Crescent Solitaire
pages.creator: Arkadium
pages.description: Move cards from a curved tableau in Arkadium's Crescent Solitaire. Work with two decks and transfer the outer piles onto the eight central foundations. Choose available moves that uncover more cards and continue reducing the crescent until the deal is cleared.

pages.title: Extreme Bounce
pages.creator: Red Eye Production
pages.description: Draw supports for a falling ball in Extreme Bounce. Place a line at the right angle and moment to send the ball into a useful rebound. Collect the stars and complete ten levels whose different layouts require changes to the drawing and timing.

pages.title: Bff Spring Beach Holiday
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Choose seaside looks for two friends in Bff Spring Beach Holiday. Browse clothing and accessories for their spring weekend trip, then put together an outfit for each princess. Coordinate the selected pieces to complete both characters' preparations for the beach.

pages.title: Dinosaurs World Hidden Miniature
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Search prehistoric scenes in Dinosaurs World Hidden Miniature. Find the small dinosaurs concealed within each picture before the countdown ends. Work through five levels, comparing details around the landscape to locate the remaining creatures and improve the result.

pages.title: Warscrap
pages.creator: WarScrap Studio
pages.description: Join other fighters against a machine army in Warscrap. Move through third-person combat and coordinate attacks with fellow players to defeat the mechanical force. The shared battle centers on supporting the team while responding to the enemies around you.

pages.title: Minesweeper, a Classic puzzle game
pages.creator: LDGEngineering
pages.description: Locate hidden hazards in Minesweeper, a Classic puzzle game. Open green squares and use the revealed numbers to deduce how many neighboring spaces contain mines. Mark the suspected locations and uncover the safe area without clicking a mine, adjusting the game's settings for another layout.

pages.title: Jigsaw Puzzle: Famous Paintings
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Reconstruct works of art in Jigsaw Puzzle: Famous Paintings. Select from sixteen paintings and connect their scattered pieces using colors, outlines, and recognizable details. Complete the chosen image a section at a time before moving to another painting in the collection.

pages.title: Footgolf Evolution
pages.creator: Onduck Games
pages.description: Combine a football with hole-based courses in Footgolf Evolution. Aim the ball toward the cup while working around the unusual obstacles placed along the route. Complete twenty-four holes by judging where each shot will leave the ball for the next attempt.

pages.title: Ice Couple Princess Magic Date
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Prepare a royal pair for a winter evening in Ice Couple Princess Magic Date. Choose outfits for Elsa and her prince, coordinating their clothing for the planned outing. Finish their romantic looks and select a present for the princess before the date begins.

pages.title: Celebrity Tailor Shops
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Make occasion-specific dresses in Celebrity Tailor Shops. Help a designer create three outfits for her best friend, choosing the details for three different events. Complete each tailoring project and compare the finished dresses before ending the design session.

pages.title: Princess Toy Store
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Prepare a store's opening collection in Princess Toy Store. Help Rachel create the remaining superhero-princess toys and arrange them in the shop. Work through the production choices to finish the figures and get the new toy business ready for its opening day.

pages.title: Funny Monsters
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Clear groups of unusual creatures in Funny Monsters. Match at least three identical monsters together to remove them from the puzzle board. Look for another useful combination in the resulting arrangement and continue working through the matching challenge.

pages.title: Heart Bangs
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Create a distinctive fringe in Heart Bangs. Follow the hairstyling activity to shape the character's bangs around a heart-inspired look. Work through the available salon steps and finish the hairstyle with the details you want for the completed makeover.

pages.title: Highschool Prom
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Style three friends for an evening dance in Highschool Prom. Choose formal dresses, add sparkling accessories, and match each hairstyle to the outfit. Give the girls individual looks while completing their preparations for the shared prom-night event.

pages.title: Goldie Princesses Pregnant BFFs H5
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Follow two characters through a care routine in Goldie Princesses Pregnant BFFs H5. Help the princesses take vitamins and eat, then choose dresses for their finished looks. Complete the daily activities together before ending the pregnancy-themed care and styling session.
